name: Declared Evidence Check Acceptance (evidence-check-accept)
description: C02 consume-side demo: `verify-attempt` produces an accepted attempt report, the declared `evidence-check-accept` route restores its stored sequence + check record and reports accepted; the same check against a foreign sequence reports candidate_match false and accepted false.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C02 consume side end to end: produce an accepted attempt report through verify-attempt, restore its sequence and check record through evidence-check-accept for accepted:true, then show a foreign sequence can never accept that check.
artifact_contracts: Step 1 runs `python -m agent verify-attempt` on identity.mm and asserts acceptance.accepted is true with candidate_match.
Step 2 restores the report's sequence + evidence_check records through `evidence-check-accept` and asserts accepted true with candidate_match.
Step 3 runs verify-attempt on the foreign source other.mm, then evaluates the first check record against the foreign sequence and asserts candidate_match false and accepted false.

Generate evidence: attempt.log, accept.log, foreign.log, attempt.json, foreign_attempt.json, sequence.json, check.json, foreign_sequence.json, accept.json, foreign_accept.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: evidence-check-accept is the consume half of produce+consume: it restores declared records only and performs no Core run — a stale or foreign check always yields accepted:false.
acceptance is representation-level: the six semantic checks (claim_truth, file_identity, freshness, producer_authenticity, semantic_correspondence, artifact_semantics) stay in checks_not_performed.
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is evidence-check-accept-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: verify-attempt: accepted attempt report
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_check_accept/src/identity.mm --output {output_dir}/attempt.json > {output_dir}/attempt.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/attempt.json; cat {output_dir}/attempt.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/attempt.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.verify-attempt-report/v1' and r['acceptance']['accepted'] is True and r['acceptance']['candidate_match'] is True, r.get('acceptance'); print('verify-attempt: accepted attempt report')"
steps.artifact_contract: attempt.json binds schema mumei.verify-attempt-report/v1 with acceptance.accepted true for identity.mm.
steps.verifier_gate: verify-attempt exits 0, reports acceptance.accepted true with candidate_match.

steps.name: evidence-check-accept: stored check accepted
steps.command: python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/attempt.json')); json.dump(r['sequence'], open('{output_dir}/sequence.json','w'), indent=2); json.dump(r['evidence_check'], open('{output_dir}/check.json','w'), indent=2)" && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-accept --sequence {output_dir}/sequence.json --check {output_dir}/check.json --output {output_dir}/accept.json > {output_dir}/accept.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/accept.json; cat {output_dir}/accept.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/accept.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-check-acceptance/v1' and r['accepted'] is True and r['candidate_match'] is True, r; print('evidence-check-accept: stored check accepted')"
steps.artifact_contract: accept.json binds schema mumei.evidence-check-acceptance/v1 with accepted true and candidate_match true for the attempt's own sequence.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-check-accept exits 0 and reports accepted true for the stored check against its own sequence.

steps.name: evidence-check-accept: foreign sequence cannot accept
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_check_accept/src/other.mm --output {output_dir}/foreign_attempt.json > {output_dir}/foreign.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/foreign.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/foreign_attempt.json')); json.dump(r['sequence'], open('{output_dir}/foreign_sequence.json','w'), indent=2)" && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-accept --sequence {output_dir}/foreign_sequence.json --check {output_dir}/check.json --output {output_dir}/foreign_accept.json > {output_dir}/foreign_accept.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/foreign_accept.json; cat {output_dir}/foreign_accept.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/foreign_accept.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-check-acceptance/v1' and r['candidate_match'] is False and r['accepted'] is False, r; print('evidence-check-accept: foreign sequence rejected')"
steps.artifact_contract: foreign_accept.json binds schema mumei.evidence-check-acceptance/v1 with candidate_match false and accepted false for the foreign sequence.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-check-accept exits 0 while reporting candidate_match false and accepted false — a stale or foreign check can never forge acceptance.

narrative.moment: Own stored check binds; foreign sequence fails closed.
intro: Step 1: verify-attempt produces an accepted attempt report against a real Core...
Step 2: evidence-check-accept restores the stored sequence + check record and accepts...
Step 3: the same check record evaluated against a foreign sequence reports candidate_match false and accepted false...
narrative.before: The consume half of produce+consume had no end-to-end coverage: whether a stored check record can be restored and accepted was only unit-tested.
narrative.after: evidence-check-accept restores declared records and accepts the attempt's own check while a foreign sequence can never forge acceptance.
